title: MCP Swift SDK
excerpt: MCP Swift SDK Official Swift SDK for the [Model Context Protocol][mcp] (MCP). Overview The Model Context Protocol (MCP) defines a standardized way for applications to communicate with AI and ML models. This Swift SDK implements both client and server components according to the [2025 11 25][mcp spec 2025 11 25] (latest) version of the MCP specification.
